'''Raspard''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] member of the [[InterStellar Regulators]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], she contacted the Regulator post 2X9 in [[Communications Bunker 75]] for the all-clear signal.<ref name="TOR Rise of the Hutt Cartel" />
